name: Stereo dissecting microscope
purpose: Manipulate small devices, tissue and connectors.
geometryBrief: Stand, zoom head, binoculars, working-distance stage and illuminator.
behaviorBrief: Stereo inspection, focus and zoom; render specimen to correct scale.
inputs: Specimen mesh or volume, calibrated zoom and stereo geometry, focus and stage transform
outputs: Left/right inspection views, scale bar and sample-space pointer location
acceptance: Image a calibrated grid with an elevated fiducial. Grid spacing should match its scale bar at two zoom settings and the raised point should show the expected disparity sign.
geometryStatus: Built: metric V12 silhouette, optics and manufactured ruler
simulationStatus: First pass: verified scale and ideal stereo disparity direction
integrationStatus: Linked: binocular views, sample pointer and JSON

name: Inverted research microscope
purpose: Observe cell cultures, MEAs and fluorescence samples.
geometryBrief: Motorized stage, inverted nosepiece, camera ports, enclosure and controls.
behaviorBrief: Sample navigation, optical magnification and exposure; objective-specific view.
inputs: Culture or MEA sample ID, stage pose, objective calibration, exposure and channel selection
outputs: Objective-tagged calibrated image, focal-plane transform and exposure metadata
acceptance: Image a calibration grid with two objective profiles. The measured physical pitch should stay constant and the field of view should shrink with increasing magnification for a fixed camera.
simulationStatus: Inert 10×/20× reticle pitch and calibrated FOV verified
related: Ti2-E exterior, sources and independent reticle checks

name: Laser scanning confocal
model: ZEISS LSM 980 with Airyscan 2 · side-port documentary configuration
purpose: Acquire optical sections and fluorescence stacks.
geometryBrief: Microscope stand, scan head, laser rack, stage and workstation.
behaviorBrief: PSF-based sectioning, channel selection and scan sampling; no generic nanometer resolution claim.
inputs: Labeled fluorescence volume, channel-specific measured PSF, scan grid and acquisition mode
outputs: Registered channel stack, voxel spacing and optical-section metadata
acceptance: Image isolated sub-resolution beads using a reference scan profile. Compare lateral and axial widths to held-out bead measurements and verify that a channel lacking fluorophore remains at background.
geometryStatus: Passive metric layout on documented active table; hardware shapes inferred
simulationStatus: Synthetic analytic plane inspection and width checks only; no hardware acquisition
integrationStatus: Viewer and synthetic plane PNG/CSV/JSON; experimental acceptance not run

name: STED super-resolution
purpose: Inspect finer fluorescent structures in appropriate samples.
geometryBrief: Microscope, scan head, laser rack and optical bench.
behaviorBrief: Modality-specific resolution and reference image analysis; validate PSF before quantitative predictions.
inputs: Fluorophore phantom or raw reference image, mode-specific measured PSF and pixel spacing
outputs: Resolution-tagged STED or confocal image, measured feature widths and calibration provenance
acceptance: Use isolated beads from a matched confocal/STED reference pair. Recovered widths should fall inside their respective calibration intervals, with the observed difference reproduced under those reference conditions.
integrationStatus: Interactive image viewer and profile export

name: Spinning-disk confocal
model: Yokogawa CSU-W1 on Nikon TiE (configuration reference)
purpose: Fast optical sectioning for dynamic cultures.
geometryBrief: Inverted microscope, disk scan module, camera and laser delivery.
behaviorBrief: Time-series stacks, exposure and motion effects.
inputs: Moving fluorescent volume, disk-section response, exposure windows and z-stack schedule
outputs: Time-indexed optical stacks with per-plane timestamps and motion blur
acceptance: Move a fluorescent point at constant known speed. Its centroid should follow the midpoint of each exposure and the added motion blur should grow with speed × exposure.
geometryStatus: First-pass metric exterior GLB and original source
simulationStatus: Static instrument and offline synthetic grid registration
integrationStatus: Linked standalone scene; no hardware or other station connection

name: Two-photon microscope
purpose: Image fluorescent structures at depth in suitable samples.
geometryBrief: Upright/intravital microscope, laser module, scan optics and workstation.
behaviorBrief: Depth attenuation, excitation PSF and fluorescence time series; distinguish calibrated from illustrative depth.
inputs: Fluorescent volume, nonlinear excitation PSF, attenuation model and scan schedule
outputs: Depth-indexed fluorescence images and timestamps with optical parameters
acceptance: Use uniform, unsaturated virtual fluorophore without bleaching. Doubling excitation intensity at a fixed depth should quadruple two-photon fluorescence in the quadratic model.
simulationStatus: Verified passive inert XY/XZ stack; no excitation model
related: Axio Examiner NLO display and checked passive stack

name: Light-sheet microscope
purpose: Image optically cleared tissue and suitable living samples.
geometryBrief: Enclosure, sample chamber, illumination objectives and detection objective.
behaviorBrief: Multi-view stack, light sheet position, registration and voxel scale.
inputs: Fluorescent specimen, illumination and detection poses, view transforms and voxel spacing
outputs: Per-view stacks, registered volume and transforms to the specimen frame
acceptance: Acquire a fiducial phantom from two simulated orientations. After registration corresponding beads should co-locate within the declared resampling tolerance.
geometryStatus: First-pass metric dormant main module and a separate visual replay display
simulationStatus: Verified offline synthetic inert plane coordinates and scale only; no acquisition or registration
integrationStatus: Interactive enclosure, plane replay, export and stable metric room/VR actions

name: Lattice light-sheet
geometryBrief: Enclosed optical system, sample holder, objective geometry and console.
behaviorBrief: Time-resolved optical sections; separate photobleaching model from growth.
inputs: Time-indexed fluorescent volume, effective lattice PSF, plane schedule and bleaching model
outputs: Time-resolved optical sections, exposure history and separated bleaching metadata
acceptance: Image stationary fluorescent fiducials with bleaching switched on and off. Centroids should remain fixed while only the enabled run follows the selected intensity-decay curve.
geometryStatus: Built: metric sealed Lattice module and separate playback desk
simulationStatus: First pass: synthetic stack viewer only; acquisition and bleaching outside scope
integrationStatus: Linked: read-only plane picker and exports

name: Structured illumination
purpose: Resolve fluorescence structures using structured patterns.
geometryBrief: Microscope, pattern module, camera and workstation.
behaviorBrief: SIM reconstruction from synthetic or reference raw patterns; flag artifacts.
inputs: Raw patterned frames, phase and orientation labels, optical transfer function and pixel scale
outputs: Reconstructed SIM image, reconstruction configuration and artifact flags
acceptance: Generate patterned frames for a known grating within the modeled passband. Recover its spatial frequency and orientation. Remove a required phase frame and check that reconstruction is flagged incomplete.
geometryStatus: First pass: metric stationary exterior; nominal 1200 × 900 mm table verified; individual housings inferred
simulationStatus: First pass: passive staged synthetic grating comparison and Fourier inspection; original SIM acceptance deferred
integrationStatus: First pass: simulator route, metric GLB, stable display action, sample export and targeted local verification

name: Automated slide scanner
purpose: Digitize histology slides and mosaic tissue images.
geometryBrief: Slide tray, loading door, objective assembly and workstation.
behaviorBrief: Tile scanning, focus map, stitched image and scale.
inputs: Slide ID, focus surface, tile coordinates, overlap and calibrated pixel spacing
outputs: Pyramidal slide mosaic, tile transforms, focus map and physical scale
acceptance: Scan a grid slide with repeated features crossing tile boundaries. After stitching each fiducial should appear once and seam displacement should meet the predetermined pixel tolerance.
integrationStatus: Interactive mapped tile viewer and exports

name: Laser microdissection
purpose: Represent region selection from sectioned tissue.
geometryBrief: Microscope, laser module, sample stage and collection holder.
behaviorBrief: Region-of-interest selection and sample lineage; no real tissue protocol.
inputs: Registered section image, parent section ID, physical scale and closed ROI polygon
outputs: Derived virtual sample ID, ROI mask, physical area and parent-to-ROI transform
acceptance: Select a rectangle on a synthetic calibrated section. The reported area should match its width × height within rasterization error and the child mask should map to the same parent pixels.
geometryStatus: First-pass metric static exterior GLB with editable source
simulationStatus: Dormant instrument; independent fictional polygon area board
integrationStatus: Standalone browser station; no hardware or specimen connection
